name: Bronte Callaghan
bio:
Bronte's journey into motorsport started unconventionally, fixing up go-karts with her dad in their backyard shed in rural New South Wales. While her dreams of being behind the wheel never quite materialized, her passion for the technical side of racing never waned. After completing a degree in mechanical engineering, she cut her teeth in various support roles before finding her niche in test driver coordination.

At Toyota Gazoo Racing BR, Bronte is the linchpin connecting engineers, drivers, and the race cars themselves. She thrives on the meticulous planning and logistical challenges of managing complex testing schedules. Her pragmatic approach ensures that resources are used efficiently and that the team extracts maximum value from every test session. Bronte is known for her unwavering commitment to detail and her ability to anticipate potential problems before they arise, making her an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Bronte is of average height, with a slender build and a determined look in her eyes.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool on her keychain.
Has a habit of clicking her pen when deep in thought.
Insists on using a paper planner despite the team's reliance on digital calendars.
